Acceptance_Notes: One shared high-current supply for both loads; common feed wiring fuse and BMS measured-current acceptance required
One common high-current return distribution with star-like connections; prevent high-current return through logic conductors
Parallel tap from common battery bus; no motor-only battery separate supply or switch
Observe MDD20A manufacturer terminal names and polarity before real hookup
Parallel tap from common battery bus not from MDD board terminal; VH must remain >= VL regulated 5V
Existing factory 10A slow blow VH fuse is not independent coil pulse protection
Low-current voltage sensing only; 0.1ohm shunt never in motor or coil power path
5V logical input remains separate regulated voltage but powered ultimately from same 3S battery
